description: This file implements a channel health monitoring system for a gateway, including configuration types, dependency injection, and the main function to start and stop the monitor, which periodically checks channel health and restarts unhealthy channels within specified limits.

methods.name: resolveTimingPolicy
methods.description: Resolves timing policy parameters, applying defaults and deprecated options.

methods.name: startChannelHealthMonitor
methods.description: Initializes and starts the channel health monitoring process, returning an object with a stop method.
